name: Jiang Su Suyan Jingshen Co.,Ltd
summary: Jiang Su Suyan Jingshen Co.,Ltd. engages in the mining, research, production, distribution, and sale of salt and salt chemicals in China. The company offers two-alkali and small industrial salt, edible salts, soda ash, calcium chloride, baking soda, and other products. The company also offers able salt, industrial salt for alkali production, sodium sulfate, small-scale industrial salt, packaging bags, and brine. The company was formerly known as Jiangsu Jingshen Salt & Chemical Industry Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Jiang Su Suyan Jingshen Co.,Ltd. in January 2019.
